Estimating each item on the plate (portions judged from the photo):

- Scrambled eggs: about 100 g, ~150 kcal
- Roasted potatoes: about 60 g, ~90 kcal
- Cooked onions or leeks: about 30 g, ~25 kcal
- Bacon: about 3 strips at roughly 8 g each, 24 g total, ~130 kcal
- Crumbled sausage or hash: about 50 g, ~200 kcal

That adds up to about 264 g and 595 kcal. I rounded to 600 kcal and 270 g.
